I feel it’s important to share my experience so others can be cautious when paying here.

When it came time to pay, I was told they only accepted cash — yet they did accept card. If you pay by card, please be very careful. I was told my first payment hadn’t gone through and was asked to pay again. Unfortunately, I realised too late that I had been charged twice, and they were unable to arrange a refund.

I also found their pricing inconsistent. My wife and father-in-law had massages on different days, and when I went the following day, I was quoted a noticeably higher price. I came hoping for a calm and relaxing experience, but it began with stress and confusion over the cost, and ended days later with the disappointment of discovering the duplicate charge on my account.

As a visitor from the UK, I will say the massage itself was genuinely lovely. However, the dishonest payment tactics and inconsistent pricing completely overshadowed the experience. I strongly advise others to be extremely cautious if you choose to visit.

Following on from the above, I had chased for a refund on many occasions. After several weeks on waiting, my second payment was restored.

The spa had reached out to me to try to remove my review, but I truly believe my experience should be shared. My key advice for Pranaa is to have consistency in pricing and payment methods. When there is an error, try to resolve asap or if there’s a delay then keep the customer informed.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with this spa, especially considering the lack of transparency and professionalism in their package policies.

I visited on a special personal occasion and opted for a standard package that was clearly communicated as being the same for everyone. I did not ask for any special concessions despite the occasion. Later, when I recommended a friend to this place, I was surprised to learn that they were offered a significantly better deal for a similar package—without any special occasion or justification.

As an Ayurvedic doctor, I value ethical practices and consistency. When I brought this discrepancy to the management’s attention, I was assured that the difference would be adjusted fairly. Based on this assurance, I continued with the therapy.

However, when I visited again, I was informed—after reaching there—that no such adjustment would be honored and that I would need to pay an additional amount. This was despite the fact that the matter had been clearly discussed earlier, while my original package was still ongoing.

This kind of inconsistency, lack of commitment to what is promised, and differential treatment of clients is highly unprofessional. A wellness space should operate with integrity and uniform policies for all clients.

Unfortunately, due to this experience, I would not recommend this place to anyone seeking a fair and professional spa experience.
